categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in manufacturing and trading of steel pipes, galvanized steel pipes, steel pipe fittings, hot-rolled and cold-rolled steel coils and sheets, steel billets, structural steel, stainless steel coils, silicon steel coils, and coated steel coils. It also operates in heat treatment processing, motorcycle and bicycle manufacturing and assembly, real estate development and leasing, livestock farming, import-export trade, waste recycling and treatment, chemical and industrial additive manufacturing, metal building structures, product design, and leasing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced steel pipe production technologies including submerged arc welded (SAW) steel pipes, galvanized steel pipe manufacturing, and API-certified oil and gas pipes. It emphasizes production efficiency improvements, energy saving, pollution prevention, and workplace safety. Equipment upgrades include replacement of old pipe manufacturing machines, API small and medium pipe production lines, and galvanizing furnaces. The company holds ISO 9001, CNS, API, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications, reflecting quality and environmental management standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction, fire protection, engineering, water conservancy, petrochemical, oil and gas, machinery, furniture, automotive, motorcycle, bicycle, and electronics industries. Major domestic clients are large public and private enterprises such as CPC Corporation, Taiwan Power Company, military, and Formosa Plastics. The company serves both domestic and export markets, with significant sales in Taiwan and North America, particularly the U.S. market for API oil pipes.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and Pingtung. Export markets include North America, Northeast Asia, and Southeast Asia, with a focus on the U.S. market for API-certified steel pipes. The company also has sales offices in Taipei and maintains supply relationships with domestic and international steel suppliers from China, Brazil, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the steel industry, focusing on processing and manufacturing steel pipes and related products from raw steel coils and billets sourced from upstream steel producers. It also engages in downstream activities such as product sales and distribution to end users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, increasing steel pipe production capacity, and improving production efficiency through equipment modernization. The company invests in energy-saving and pollution prevention technologies and maintains certifications to meet environmental and safety standards. It aims to develop domestic and international sales channels, diversify product offerings, and pursue product differentiation to maintain competitive advantages. R&D focuses on upgrading manufacturing equipment and complying with international standards such as API 5CT for oil well casing pipes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of steel pipes, galvanized steel pipes, steel coils, and related steel products. Additional income streams include rental income from investment properties and processing fees. The company also earns dividend income from equity investments and engages in trading activities related to steel materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic steel pipe manufacturers such as Meiya, Zhonghong, Xinyang, Far Eastern Machinery, and Tiansheng. It holds a market share of approximately 6.91% in the domestic steel pipe market and about 15.59% in the galvanized steel pipe segment. The company positions itself as a quality-focused manufacturer with strong brand reputation, certified products, and flexible production capabilities to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately NT$1.458 billion, with a net profit of NT$48.73 million and earnings per share of NT$0.26. Production volume was about 32,476 metric tons, with sales volume slightly increasing by 1% compared to the previous year. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets of NT$7.86 billion and equity of NT$3.54 billion. Despite challenges from global steel market conditions and trade policies, the company shows cautious optimism for growth in 2025 with expected sales volume increases and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, compliance with international standards (ISO 9001, API, CNS), and reliable delivery schedules. It offers a comprehensive product range with flexibility in order fulfillment and maintains strong customer relationships to ensure satisfaction. The company’s focus on energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, and workplace safety further differentiates it in the market. Its strategic investments in equipment modernization and product certification support its competitive edge in both domestic and export markets.
